reading.title: The Impact of Renewable Energy on Modern Society
reading.passage: Renewable energy sources such as solar and wind power have become increasingly important in addressing climate change and reducing dependence on fossil fuels. Many countries have invested billions in developing renewable energy infrastructure. Solar panels have become more efficient and affordable, making them accessible to homeowners and businesses. Wind turbines generate electricity in coastal and rural areas. However, challenges remain, including energy storage and intermittency issues. Despite these obstacles, renewable energy is expected to comprise a significant portion of global electricity generation by 2050.

questions.q: According to the passage, which of the following is mentioned as a challenge for renewable energy?
options: High cost of installation
Energy storage and intermittency issues
Lack of government support
Environmental damage
questions.explanation: 본문에서 '도전 과제로 남아 있는 것은 에너지 저장과 간헐성 문제'라고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What does the passage suggest about solar panels?
options: They are only suitable for large businesses
They have become more efficient and affordable
They cannot generate enough electricity
They are no longer being developed
questions.explanation: 본문에서 '태양 전지판은 더 효율적이고 저렴해졌으며, 주택 소유자와 기업이 접근할 수 있게 되었다'고 설명합니다.

questions.q: According to the passage, when is renewable energy expected to comprise a significant portion of global electricity?
questions.explanation: 본문의 마지막 문장에서 '2050년까지 재생에너지가 전 지구적 전기 생산의 상당한 부분을 차지할 것으로 예상된다'고 명시되어 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement: 'Technology has improved the quality of human life more than it has harmed it.' Support your opinion with specific reasons and examples.

structure.intro: 주장을 명확히 제시합니다. '기술이 인류의 삶의 질을 해친 것보다 더 많이 개선했다는 것에 동의한다/동의하지 않는다'고 명확하게 시작하세요.
structure.body1: 첫 번째 이유: 의료 기술의 발전으로 질병 치료와 평균 수명 증가. 구체적 예시: 항생제, 백신 개발
structure.body2: 두 번째 이유: 통신 기술이 전 세계 사람들을 연결하고 정보 접근성 향상. 예시: 인터넷, 스마트폰의 교육 활용
structure.conclusion: 앞서 제시한 이유들을 요약하고 기술의 긍정적 영향에 대한 최종 의견을 제시합니다.

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer to work in large companies with many employees. Others prefer to work in small businesses or startups. Which do you prefer and why?
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer working in...
sample_points: 첫 번째 포인트: 대기업은 안정적인 급여, 복리후생, 명확한 커리어 경로를 제공합니다. 예를 들어, 건강보험, 퇴직금, 체계적인 승진 제도 등이 있습니다.
두 번째 포인트: 스타트업은 창의성과 혁신의 기회를 제공합니다. 근로자들이 회사의 성장에 직접 영향을 미칠 수 있고, 다양한 업무 경험을 얻을 수 있습니다.

listening.title: University Library Research Support
listening.script: Student: Excuse me, I'm working on my research paper about climate change, but I'm having trouble finding reliable sources. Librarian: I can definitely help you with that! First, I'd recommend using our academic database, which has peer-reviewed articles and scholarly journals. You can access it from our library website using your student ID. Student: That sounds helpful. What about books? Librarian: Great question! You can search our catalog for books on climate science. I'd also suggest checking out our 'Research Guide for Environmental Studies' which lists the best resources by topic. Additionally, we offer one-on-one research consultations if you'd like personalized guidance. Student: One-on-one help would be perfect! When can I schedule an appointment? Librarian: You can book a session online through our website, or you can visit the reference desk during our regular hours. Most consultations are 30 minutes to an hour. Student: Perfect, thank you so much! Librarian: You're welcome! Good luck with your research paper.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of this conversation?
options: To explain how to use the library's online catalog
To provide research support and guidance for a student's paper
To promote the library's new academic database
To discuss climate change research methods
questions.explanation: 도서관 사서가 학생의 연구 논문을 위해 신뢰할 수 있는 자료를 찾는 방법을 여러 가지 설명해주고 있습니다. 이것이 대화의 주요 목적입니다.

questions.q: According to the librarian, how can the student access the academic database?
options: By visiting the reference desk in person
By requesting help from a research consultant
By accessing it from the library website using their student ID
By searching the library's general catalog
questions.explanation: 사서가 '학생 ID를 사용하여 도서관 웹사이트에서 접근할 수 있다'고 명확히 설명했습니다.

questions.q: What does the librarian suggest as an additional resource?
options: A peer-reviewed journal on environmental studies
A Research Guide for Environmental Studies
A one-hour consultation session
A climate change textbook
questions.explanation: 사서가 '환경 연구를 위한 연구 가이드를 확인하라'고 추천했으며, 이 자료가 주제별 최고의 자료 목록을 제공한다고 설명합니다.
